Re-check these debrid records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- debrid/brfiles $.free_tier.metered_on: Page is premium plan list; says nothing about a free tier metering.
- debrid/baixarpremium $.egress.terms: Page shows per-period prices only; nothing about egress or host transfer allowances.
- debrid/baixarpremium $.verdict: Page lists hosts; it does not say they are separate accounts, and holds no verdict.
- debrid/baixarpremium $.per_object_cap.stated: Page names no object cap and says nothing about host per-file caps.
- debrid/avaxhome $.binding: Page says "you must be registered" to download; binding none is not stated.
- debrid/baixarpremium $.interface_detail: WooCommerce, delivery after payment and absence of API are not on the page.
- debrid/brfiles $.retention.stated: Span supports files do not expire; "while the subscription is live" and activity-independence are not on the page.
- debrid/ddlbase $.interface_detail: Capture proves an RSS list only; content-type, 300 items, self-link, sitemap and /feed/ 404 are not in it.
- debrid/lucaspremium $.identity_cost.detail: Quote "Envio Imediato - Entrega automatica em Segundos" is not on the page (it says "Envio imediato apos o pagamento ser aprovado"); CPF and payment methods not addressed.
- debrid/lucaspremium $.free_tier.stated: Page shows a 30-day product; it does not say that no free or trial product exists.
- debrid/ddlbase $.free_tier.stated: Feed shows sizes in titles; the two anonymous mirror slots and "(login for more mirrors)" are on a post page, not in this capture.
- debrid/lucaspremium $.chaining: Page says credentials arrive by email; chaining with Stremio/torrent add-ons and Pix are not on it.
- debrid/baixarpremium $.binding_note: Page has no transfer allowance or 1 TiB/month statement.
- debrid/archive-by $.per_object_cap.bytes: Span gives 100 MB free and 1 GB premium; value 1073741824 assumes binary GiB and picks premium only.
- debrid/baixarpremium $.price_per_tb_month: 39.99/31 days and 58.99 are on the page, but the USD rate is not, ComboSupremo lists 34 hosts not 35, and nothing is stated per TB.
- debrid/ddlbase $.chaining: Capture does not show the chaining steps or anonymous mirrors.
- debrid/baixarpremium $.binding: Page has prices per period only; no volume quota is stated.
- debrid/brfiles $.free_tier.unit: Premium page does not state that there is no free tier.
- debrid/lucaspremium $.retention.stated: 30 days is on the page; expiry and renewal through the same seller are not.
- debrid/avaxhome $.free_tier.stated: Page says "in order to download anything on this site, you must be registered"; contradicts "No account".
- debrid/mundopremium $.free_tier.stated: Page shows a voucher for this one product; that the store sells vouchers only, and no free tier, is not shown.
